purpose: Extend the Blue-Ether environmental evidence and Premium RainWater reporting model across selected Lagos-linked geographic pilots while preserving source provenance, non-contradiction, DMRV and public-safe reporting controls.
claim_policy: A geographic node is not evidence of measurement, harvest, production or verification. Claims require source-backed observations and the configured evidence lifecycle.

node_nomenclature.representative_node: National or regional monitoring placeholder pending site qualification
node_nomenclature.harvest_node: Future authorized physical rainwater collection site

countries.name: Portugal
countries.node_plan: Portugal-wide district representation with Lagos Algarve as connector; expand to municipalities/parishes as qualified

countries.name: Chile
countries.node_plan: Los Lagos detailed sub-grid plus representative nodes for other regions; expand to provinces/communes as qualified
countries.naming_rule: Dos Lagos is project branding; Los Lagos is the official administrative reference.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.node_plan: Lagos de Moreno/Jalisco detailed representation plus one representative node per other federal entity initially
countries.data_strategy: INEGI geographic/statistical framework + approved meteorological/air-quality sources

countries.name: Brazil
countries.administrative_model: state/federal district > municipality > district > subdistrict > site
countries.node_plan: Reserve national/state/city pages and node framework; do not assign a Lagos anchor until geographic identity is confirmed

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.node_plan: Seven emirate nodes with Dubai as thematic connector; expand qualified urban/environmental sites
countries.data_strategy: UAE official environmental/air-quality infrastructure + meteorological/satellite sources

source_rule: Only documented provider capabilities may determine transport class. HTTP is POLLING_API; historical datasets are ARCHIVE_QUERY.

non_contradiction_engine.principle: Non-contradiction is established through disclosed methodology and reconciliation; sources are not blindly averaged.

premium_rainwater.rule: Premium classification must reference an evidence package and cannot be inferred from geography, forecast or branding alone.

analytics.authority: Blue-Ether canonical evidence records remain authoritative

blockchain.sequence: source -> observation -> QA -> reconciliation -> canonical evidence package -> SHA-256 evidence root -> supported network anchor -> verification registry
blockchain.rule: Blockchain anchoring does not make an unsupported environmental claim true; the source-backed evidence package remains authoritative.
